Additional effects: - On an enemy: inflicts Water damage. - On an ally: applies a shield on the target. - On one of the caster's Turrets, if the switch is successful: - Harpooner: attacks the closest enemy in line of sight in the turret's range of action. - Lifesaver: heals the closest ally in line of sight in the turret's range of action. - Tacturret: increases the turret's Lock if it is in the Magnatron state. Otherwise, increases their Pushback Damage.
